name: Pro CPQ Quote Builder
description: Configure-price-quote workspace: bundle picker with option rules, virtualised 10k-line grid with qty/discount/term, tiered and volume pricing, discount approval thresholds, exact multi-currency minor-unit totals, undo, saved versions and paginated PDF export.

props.name: products
props.description: Price book: { id, sku, name, currency, model: flat|tiered|volume, unitPrice, tiers?, billing, maxRepDiscountBp? } in minor units

props.name: bundles
props.description: Bundles with options and rules (requires, excludes, minQty, pickOne)

props.name: fx
props.description: { base, rates } decimal-string FX rates to the base currency

props.name: versions / defaultVersions / onVersionsChange
props.description: Saved snapshots; export PDF saves a new version

props.name: currencies
props.description: Selectable quote currencies (default: fx base + rates)

props.name: onRequestApproval
props.description: Submit for approval when thresholds are exceeded
